That mix is what a real in-season Saturday looks like, and it is why the synthetic `ncaaf-slate-2026-08-29-market.synthetic.json` was retired — a fixture built by feeding 2025 closes to the shipping builder can only ever confirm the shape we already assumed (E9.64b: a fixture derived from the transform cannot disconfirm it). ⚠️ THE ABSENT GAME IS A REFUSAL, not an uncaptured kickoff: `reason = market_snapshot_not_pre_kickoff`, i.e. the leakage guard declined a line it could not prove was taken before kickoff.
